cases.left: State the open-cover definition of compactness.
cases.left_answer: Every open cover has a finite subcover.
cases.right: What finite selection property must every open covering of a compact space satisfy?
cases.right_answer: Some finite subcollection still covers the entire space.

cases.left: Define P(A given B), assuming P(B)>0.
cases.right: Define P(B given A), assuming P(A)>0.

cases.left: State uniform convergence of f_n to f.
cases.left_answer: For every epsilon>0 there exists N such that for all n>=N and every x, |f_n(x)-f(x)|<epsilon.
cases.right: State pointwise convergence of f_n to f.
cases.right_answer: For every x and every epsilon>0 there exists N depending on x such that for all n>=N, |f_n(x)-f(x)|<epsilon.

cases.left: What continuity hypothesis does the intermediate value theorem require?
cases.right: What conclusion does the intermediate value theorem give?
cases.right_answer: Every value between f(a) and f(b) is attained on [a,b].

cases.left: How do you compute a determinant by row reduction?
cases.left_answer: Track row-swap signs and row-scaling factors, reduce to triangular form, and multiply the diagonal entries.
cases.right: What is the determinant of an upper triangular matrix?
cases.right_answer: The product of its diagonal entries.

cases.left: Express the posterior probability using likelihood, prior and evidence.
cases.right: State Bayes' rule for a hypothesis H after observing E.
cases.right_answer: P(H given E)=P(E given H) times P(H), divided by P(E), assuming positive P(E).
